z3.reason: UNSAT proof: at the fixed point q = p(W|o), KL(q||p) = 0 exactly; cannot have KL > 0 AND fixed-point claimed simultaneously

clifford.reason: Mutual generation cycle as Clifford grade-1 vector update in Cl(2,0); W = grade-1 vector, update = iterative projection; convergence = angle-gap decreases to 0

geomstats.reason: no Riemannian manifold computation required; geometry handled analytically

e3nn.reason: no SO(3)-equivariant neural network computation required in this probe

rustworkx.reason: Holodeck cycle as directed graph: nodes {W, p(o|W), o, q(W|o), fixed_point}; verify directed cycle with convergence attractor at fixed_point

xgi.reason: Triple hyperedge {W, O, mutual_information}: neither W nor O alone has MI; the 3-way relationship is irreducible — load-bearing for the co-generative claim

toponetx.reason: no chain complex or cell complex computation required in this probe
